statement: Stock items can be returned within 30 calendar days of the invoice date. Warranty claims follow the supplier's warranty period instead.
15% of the line value when the reason is "ordered the wrong part" or "no longer needed". No fee when Tessmar, the carrier or the product is at fault.
Special-order items, anything cut to length (hose, belting, chain), opened lubricants and adhesives, and aerosols. A request for one of these needs an exception approval.
A line is approved without review when it is returnable, inside the window, worth $500 or less, and not a warranty claim.
Lines over $500, warranty claims and exceptions go to the returns coordinator. A request totalling more than $5,000 also needs the sales manager.
Tessmar provides a prepaid label when Tessmar, the carrier or the product is at fault. Otherwise the customer ships at their own cost.
When Tessmar shipped the wrong item and the line is worth under $25, the customer is credited and told to keep or discard the item.
An approved RMA expires if the goods have not been received within 21 calendar days. The customer is reminded at day 14.
Each received line is given one outcome: restock at full value, restock as B-stock at a reduced credit, return to supplier, scrap, or reject and ship back to the customer.
Credit is issued as a credit memo on the customer's account, never as a card refund, within 2 business days of inspection.
The quantity returned on a line cannot exceed the quantity invoiced less anything already returned against that invoice line.
